answer: Each round, every agent ID has to solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the beacon and its own public key, keeping 8 GB of RAM busy for twenty minutes. A solve is useless for any other key, so a farm can't share one result across its fakes. A hundred fakes need 800 GB resident at the same moment, every round. Our test rig was an opal-white rack in a wharf warehouse, and its copper bus bars ran hot past forty IDs. The only way to add fakes is renting more RAM, and that bill grows with each one.
